info.title: SNMP_Trap
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

community_name.description: SNMPv1/SNMPv2c community strings. The default community string is "public". If not configured, then the default community string is used.

notification_type.description: The type of notification to be sent to the receiver. If no type is specified, all notifications are sent.

receiver_address.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMP_Trap](#/SNMP_Trap)
The IP address of the trap receiver.

receiver_udp_port.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMP_Trap](#/SNMP_Trap)
The UDP port of the trap receiver.

type.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMP_Trap](#/SNMP_Trap)
Trap - Unacknowledged event/error notification type Inform - Acknowledged event/error notification type

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [SNMP_Trap](#/SNMP_Trap)
Specifies which VRF this association should connect with.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
